answer: Reaching the karst of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Each submission hangs on the opal of a task receipt, and the ledge is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
